title: WireForge low-level requirement numbers (llr_ids.lock)
description: Optional file in the project directory. It gives every low-level requirement a number that never changes or returns; it is not part of the model and does not change the model hash.

format.description: Python format string with one field `n`, e.g. SWLLR-{n:05d}. The result uses only letters, digits and _ . : -.
